bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Official test assesses writing and speaking; MCQ/MR cannot assess productive skills. Mastemy teaches all four skills by video and model-answer analysis but scores only receptive and knowledge items.

items.stem: A GT Task 1 letter is to a close friend inviting them to visit. Which register fits?

options.rationale: Correct: writing to a close friend uses an informal, friendly register.
Formal tone is too distant for a close friend.
Legalistic language is inappropriate for a personal invitation.
Omitting a greeting breaks letter conventions.

items.explanation: A personal letter to a close friend uses an informal register.

items.stem: A GT Task 2 prompt asks for problems and solutions. A response lists only problems. What is the main weakness?

options.text: Incomplete task response: solutions are missing
options.rationale: Correct: the prompt requires both problems and solutions, so omitting solutions fails task response.
The core issue is the missing half of the task, not spelling.
Paragraph count is not the main problem here.
Synonym use is not the central weakness.

items.explanation: Both problems and solutions are required; omitting solutions is a task-response failure.

options.text: Addressing all three bullet points clearly
options.rationale: Correct: full bullet coverage is central to task achievement.

options.text: Adding unrelated content to reach the word count
options.rationale: Off-task padding does not help task achievement.
